notes.title: RYB has been updated
notes.content:
This update brings the following:

1. In the settings menu there is now a brightness slider for the background, as requested by the community.

2. The animations have been smoothed, allowing for a more pleasant experience.

3. There are many performance optimizations, which should help the game run better on older machines.


Thank you!

FLEB
